items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you think by following Jimmie Lunceford, that’s why you guys played so good back there too? [INTERVIEWEE] No, we just had a good band.

ctx.x: [They played in the same show with Jimmie Lunceford.]
[But they were never as prominent in California.] I don’t think it’s jazz orientation. I’m going back to New York. [laughter]
